messages:
carla: Quick heads-up — opened a PR to add a migration guide for Private -> VPC installs that includes an SDK example for connecting via an internal KMS proxy in air-gapped setups. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823. Need docs + security eyes on the SDK snippet and the short network checklist.

mike: Can you paste the SDK snippet here? I hit a TLS error when I tried the example from the PR.

carla: Pasting the current snippet from the PR (Python + curl):
```python
# example: connect to private deployment behind a KMS proxy
import os
from redwood import RedwoodClient

os.environ["REDWOOD_ENDPOINT"] = "https://private.redwood.internal:9701"
os.environ["REDWOOD_KMS_PROXY"] = "https://kms-proxy.local:8200"
os.environ["REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE"] = "/etc/ssl/private-ca.pem"  # airgap: use mirrored CA

client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate("Summarize the migration steps")
print(resp.text)
```

# curl example for preflight (air-gapped installer check)
```bash
curl --cacert /etc/ssl/private-ca.pem -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \
  https://private.redwood.internal:9701/v1/health
```

sam: Security notes: this is useful but please DO NOT show real tokens in examples. Use placeholders like $REDWOOD_TOKEN or {{KMS_PROXY_URL}}. Also add a short HSM note: when using PKCS#11 set `PKCS11_MODULE_PATH` and `PKCS11_PIN` and mount the device path (e.g. /var/run/hsm).

jenna: Docs nit: include the offline bundle mirroring step and checksum verification snippet. e.g. `sha256sum installer-offline-v1.2.tar.gz` and where to upload the mirrored artifacts in the private registry.

mike: small networking check — in our QA lab the node-to-engine port was 9701 for private installs (HTTP/gRPC gateway), not 8443. Might be worth listing both common ports and the fallback used by the installer.

carla: good catches — I updated the PR: replaced inline token examples with placeholders, added HSM env var notes, and added the `sha256sum` line and mirror path. I also changed the port table to list 9701 as primary for node<>engine and 8443 as an alternate.

ci-bot: build/ docs-pr-4823 — SUCCESS in 58s :white_check_mark:

sam: LGTM from security once the HSM example removes any sample PIN values (make it a variable). Also add a one-line about rotating KMS tokens post-migration (link to rotation playbook).

jenna: I'll do a quick copyedit tomorrow morning (small wording + link fix to the installer mirror docs).

mike: I re-tested the updated snippet in an airgap lab with the mirrored CA bundle — works for me. :thumbsup:

carla: thanks everyone. I'll merge the PR tomorrow at 09:30 PT if there are no other objections. Leaving this thread open for any last-minute issues.
